The Chewiest Oat Cookies

Yield: 24 cookies

Ingredients

  • 1 cup (226g) butter, browned
  • 1 ½ cups brown sugar
  • 2 large eggs
  • 3 cups rolled oats

Instructions

  1. Brown the butter and let it cool slightly.
  2. Whisk in the sugar and eggs.
  3. Fold in the oats and bake at 350°F for 11 minutes.

Instructions

  1. Not a step from this recipe.
